releaseNotes:
SMC Tools 2.1.0 includes the v2 platform upgrade and the following additions.

V2 / 2.0 - REVIT PLATFORM AND COORDINATION

- Migrates the add-in and updater to .NET 8 for Windows x64, with separate Revit 2025 and 2026 DLLs, runtime files, and installer payloads. This installer does not support Revit 2024.
- BETA - Adds Auto Revision Cloud: capture immutable sheet baselines, compare sheet-visible content, review before/after changes, and apply selected revision clouds. Supports local, Desktop Connector, and Autodesk Docs storage, schedule-change localization, and resumable uploads tracked separately for each destination.
- Adds QA equipment-power coordination, including equipment relationships, feed-role designations, comparison workflows, and managed native coordination schedules.
- Improves document safety across modeless tools: actions remain tied to the document that opened the window, queued requests are protected, and external events are cleaned up when windows close.
- Improves Fast Circuit responsiveness and batches Apply changes into one transaction; Cancel leaves the model unchanged.
- Improves performance and reliability in Transfer Equipment Names, Check Missing Power, Circuit Load Namer, QA Review, Circuit Phase Mapper, Panel Name Builder, and Circuit Wire Sizer through cached lookups, guarded edits, current Revit APIs, and 64-bit element IDs.
- Improves Create/Rename Panel Schedules and Primary/Alternate Schedules, including faster schedule lookup and safer queued actions.
- BETA - Improves Model Spell Check settings and dictionary deployment, Key Plan Selector batch handling, nested Select Group Members, linked-DWG inspection, and Designer Notes scans.
- Improves Keynote Manager responsiveness and preserves UTF-8, UTF-16, and Windows-1252 file encodings during atomic file updates.
- Adds more durable per-user settings and diagnostics; preserves existing shared-parameter definitions during migration. Update checks run off the UI thread and installer downloads are validated by URL, size, and SHA-256 checksum.
- Adds version-specific installer payload validation and safer install/upgrade/uninstall cleanup. Debug automation and unfinished prototype tools are not exposed as production features.

2.1.0 - CIRCUIT WIRE SIZER AND VOLTAGE-DROP REPORTING

- Adds Excel and CSV reports with selectable columns and default sorting by panel name, then circuit number.
- Adds persistent neutral overrides stored in the project and shared between sessions/users. Select multiple circuits and choose Include, Omit, or Auto from the Neutral cell. Overrides apply to eligible 208V/480V two- and three-pole circuits; one-pole circuits retain a neutral.
- Adds Current VD and Current VD % using the actual Current Circuit wire size and parallel sets. Reports use current model callouts rather than base-wire sizing or unapplied recommendations. Base and calculated proposal values remain available for comparison.
- Uses the existing copper/steel-conduit impedance and 0.90 power-factor assumptions, distributed-path calculations where available, and end-load fallback otherwise. Unsupported callouts show Not calculated instead of an invented result.
- Creates or updates the native Revit schedule ELECTRICAL BRANCH CIRCUIT - VOLTAGE DROP while retaining its identity and sheet placements.
- Uses the current Wire Sizer filters. The Electrical Circuit project parameter Show in VD Schedule is set to 1 for included circuits and 0 for excluded circuits on publication. Blank panel/load names are excluded by default, with an option to include them.
- Uses these default report headers: PANEL, CKT #, LOAD NAME, V/PH/W, CKT RATING, CKT LOAD, CKT LENGTH, WIRE SIZE, VD, VD %. Only load and length receive additional rounding, to whole amps and feet; other values retain their displayed precision.
- Sets schedule title, headers, and body to Arial regular, not bold, at 1/32-inch text height.
- Adds a compact dated snapshot notice, Schedule Information, Open Schedule, and the red warning: THIS SCHEDULE DOES NOT UPDATE AUTOMATICALLY, RE-RUN IF ANY WIRE SIZES CHANGE.
- Adds Proceed/Cancel confirmation for workset checkout before publication and clearer Revit failure descriptions, including affected element IDs. Other users' ownership is still respected.
- Refuses publication when a circuit callout changed after analysis, helping keep the reported wire and voltage drop consistent.

USING THE UPDATED SCHEDULE

After applying wire-size changes, run Analyze Circuits, then Create / Update Revit Schedule. Schedules are published snapshots and do not update automatically. Project-specific worksharing and printed-layout checks remain necessary for your model.

This replaces the earlier installer under the same v2.1.0 number. If v2.1.0 is already installed, download and run the replacement installer manually.
